Selected Food Sources of Chromium—cont’d
DV = Daily Value. DVs were developed by the FDA to help consumers compare the nu-
trient contents of products within the context of a total diet. The DV for chromium is 
120 mcg. The percentage DV listed on the label indicates the percentage of the DV 
provided in one serving. A food providing 5% of the DV or less is a source, whereas a 
food that provides 10% to 19% of the DV is a good source. A food that provides 20% 
or more of the DV is high in that nutrient.
